chatbg-moon: Scene: a movie-poster parody at night. The mascot happily pedals a bright blue bicycle that is flying through the sky, crossing in front of a gigantic glowing pale-yellow full moon with soft craters. In the bicycle's front basket sits a small cute white-and-blue robot buddy (square head, little antenna) wrapped in a white blanket, looking out happily. Deep navy-blue night sky with small twinkling stars and a few wispy clouds; dark blue silhouettes of pine trees and rooftops along the very bottom.
chatbg-sunset: Scene: a movie-poster parody at sunset. The mascot happily pedals a bright blue bicycle that is flying through the sky, crossing in front of a gigantic warm golden setting sun. In the bicycle's front basket sits a small cute white-and-blue robot buddy (square head, little antenna) wrapped in a white blanket. Sky gradient from golden orange near the horizon to pink, then soft purple at the top, with a few flat stylized clouds; dark purple silhouettes of hills and a small town along the very bottom.
chatbg-silhouette: Scene: a movie-poster parody at night. The mascot pedals a bicycle that is flying across a gigantic glowing pale-yellow full moon, drawn entirely as a crisp solid black silhouette: the tilted cap, the round bean-shaped body, the pedaling legs and the bicycle wheels are clearly recognizable, with a small robot buddy silhouette (square head, little antenna) sitting in the front basket. Deep blue night sky with tiny stars; black silhouettes of pine trees along the very bottom.
